fullDescription: A professional healthcare service provider dashboard with a focus on emerald and sky blue aesthetics. It features a clean, data-driven layout with high-readability typography, suitable for medical practices, fintech dashboards, or SaaS admin panels. Key elements include a sticky glassmorphism header, highly rounded bento-style cards, and a sophisticated sidebar navigation with status indicators.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, modern healthcare provider dashboard utilizing an emerald (#059669) and sky blue (#0284c7) color palette. The interface balances high-density data (payments, schedules, patient records) with airy whitespace and smooth micro-interactions like vertical card translations on hover. It uses high border-radii (up to 32px) and a dual-font system (General Sans and Satoshi) to convey professional authority and modern accessibility.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using an Emerald and Sky Blue palette. Primary color: #059669; Secondary: #0284c7; Background: #F8FAFC; Sidebar/Card surface: #FFFFFF. Typography: Headings in 'General Sans' (bold, tracking-tight), body in 'Satoshi' (medium, 14px-16px). Cards must have 'border-radius: 32px', 'border: 1px solid #E2E8F0', and 'box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)'. Hover states for cards should include 'transform: translateY(-4px)' and 'box-shadow: 0 12px 20px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)'. Navigation active state: background #ECFDF5, text #059669, with a 4px solid right-border.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar Navigation
Fixed left sidebar, width 256px, background #FFFFFF, border-right 1px #E2E8F0. Top section includes a 40px emerald icon logo. Navigation links are stacked vertically with 4px spacing; each link has 12px padding, 12px border-radius, and icons. Bottom section includes a 'Practice Verified' status card in Emerald-50 and a logout button in red-500.

### Sticky Header
Height 72px, background white with 90% opacity and 12px backdrop-blur. Contains a left-aligned title/subtitle stack (Title: 18px Bold, Subtitle: 12px Slate-500) and a right-aligned utility bar with a pill-shaped search input, a notification bell with a red dot indicator, and a 40px circular hospital/profile avatar.

### Stats Grid
Four-column grid of cards. The primary card is dark (Emerald-900) with white text and an abstract circular background pattern. The other three cards are white with slate text. Each card shows a tiny uppercase label, a 24px bold currency/number value, and a footer showing a percentage trend or status text.

### Data Lists & Tables
The main area features 'Engagement Requests' as large rounded cards (24px padding) with user avatars, status badges (e.g., 'New Patient' in sky-blue), and primary/secondary action buttons. Adjacent is a 'Payment History' table with a light-gray header (#F8FAFC), 16px vertical padding on rows, and status badges (Emerald-100 for 'Disbursed').

### Side Widgets
A 300px-400px side column containing a 'Schedule' widget. Items are marked by a vertical 2px left-border (emerald for active, sky for secondary, slate for empty). Below is a support CTA card in Sky-900 background with white text and an absolute-positioned ghost icon in the corner.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Status-Timeline Item — A specialized list item for schedules with color-coded vertical markers.
Create a vertical list item with 24px left padding. On the absolute left, place a 2px wide vertical bar spanning the height of the text. Color-code the bar: #10B981 for appointments, #0EA5E9 for reviews. Include a bold 10px uppercase timestamp followed by a 14px bold title and 12px slate-500 subtitle.

### Glassmorphism Header — Sticky top navigation with blur effect.
Implement a header with 'position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40;'. Use 'background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0;'. Internal spacing: 16px vertical, 32px horizontal.

### Bento Stat Card — Information card with high corner radius and internal decorative elements.
Create a card with 'background: #064E3B' (Emerald-900), 'border-radius: 32px', 'padding: 24px'. Inside, add a decorative circle: 'width: 96px; height: 96px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); position: absolute; right: -16px; bottom: -16px; border-radius: 999px;'. Text color: #FFFFFF.

## Notas Especiais
Must use 'General Sans' for all numerical values to ensure high legibility. Ensure all interactive cards have the 4px vertical lift on hover. Do not use border-radius less than 12px for any button or 32px for any main container. Use 'emerald-600' strictly for success/verified states and 'sky-600' for informational/new states.

style.description: The design follows a professional 'Med-Tech' aesthetic. It pairs 'General Sans' for headings/numbers with 'Satoshi' for body copy. Primary colors are Emerald 600 (#059669) for success and verification, and Sky Blue 600 (#0284c7) for secondary emphasis. The background is a crisp Slate-50 (#F8FAFC). Components feature 32px corner radii, 1px slate-200 borders, and subtle shadow-sm. Transitions are smooth (0.3s ease) with slight lift-up effects on interactive elements.
